<Heading

>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/calendar/{token}/famlin.ics"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The URL calendar apps subscribe to. Public: there is no
`Authorization` header — the secret token in the path is the
credential, so treat the whole URL like a password.

Returns an iCalendar (RFC 5545) document with the token owner's
`EVENT` posts across every family they belong to: events that started
within the past 3 months plus every future event. It is recomputed on
every request from what the owner can see at that moment, so leaving a
family or circle removes its events on the next refresh. A
cross-posted event appears once, and each entry has a stable `UID`,
so an edited event updates the existing calendar entry.

The owner's own RSVP is reflected: `yes` → `STATUS:CONFIRMED`,
`maybe` → `STATUS:TENTATIVE`, `no` → still listed with "You declined"
in the description, no answer → a plain entry. The description holds
the family name, the author and the RSVP, plus a link to the post
only when the server's **Public address** setting is set. Comments
and photos are never included.

Responses carry `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` and `Cache-Control: private`.
Rate-limited per token. Server feature `calendarFeed`.
